summary: Frontend-only mobile regression executed on public preview URL for caregiver/doctor call-choice changes. Settings inputs rendered with correct testIDs, contact values persisted after blur/navigation, tab navigation worked, and call sheet behavior (open/dismiss/missing-contact states) was validated in focused reruns. Long-run scripts showed intermittent Metro disconnect flakiness.

integration_issues.flow: End-to-end long mobile script including contact fill + call-sheet assertion
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent Metro disconnect (1006) during automation caused flaky failures while waiting for call-sheet selectors in longer runs. Focused rerun confirmed sheet opens from both Home and Settings.

action_items: Main agent should do one quick manual mobile-web verification for the both-contacts-enabled state in the same session due observed Metro flakiness in long automation runs.
Keep dev skip-login clearly marked as MOCKED and keep tel: execution validation on real device only (browser cannot complete dialing).
Optional hardening: investigate periodic Metro websocket disconnects (1006) that can cause false-negative automation failures.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings includes distinct doctor and caregiver fields with unique testIDs and onBlur profile updates.
EmergencyButton uses unique testIDs for Home/Settings instances and gates call actions by saved phone availability.
Travel SOS remains roadmap-only in PRD; no Travel SOS/location permission/background tracking UI was found in tested flows.
frontend/.env still uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL key, while project testing contract references EXPO_BACKEND_URL.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public preview URL and mobile viewport 390x844. If onboarding appears, complete language + dev skip login (MOCKED). If Scan permission sheet appears, dismiss with cancel-camera-permission-button before tab checks. Prefer shorter focused scripts to avoid Metro 1006 false negatives.
rca_of_issue: RCA (flaky automation): In longer multi-step scripts, Metro websocket disconnect (1006) interrupts selector waits, producing false failures on contact-call-sheet checks. Reproduction: run extended onboarding+tab+settings+call workflow in one script. Mitigation: keep flows shorter and perform one manual confirmation pass for final both-contacts-enabled state in same session.
